blocks.text: Upper Ohio Valley / south Midland speech, with related Appalachian forms

The source describes regional variation and notes these forms are not used by every Ohio Valley resident. Ooh, listen for the local context rather than assuming everyone says it. I’m fond of the different ways people make room for more than one “you.” Listen for how a speaker uses it in conversation.
